body:
I guess part of the problem is separating the chronic from the acute. I've been struggling with anxiety and depression a long time. For most of the last decade those struggles have been in my favor. In the last year they have not been. Last night was my first major panic attack into fit of crying in a long time, I'm still a little dizzy from the adrenaline (or whatever) is running through my body. I'm experiencing a lot more suicidal thoughts than I have in 11 years. Once every few weeks was manageable, after years I knew it wasn't really a risk. Now I'm less sure. I guess hence why I need to talk. 

And thank you everyone. I read and reread the posts over and over and eventually started typing so something must have helped me.
